confidence_notes: Food anchors (beer, coffee, meals) rest on aggregated cost-of-living estimates from several sites, which vary and have mixed update dates; treat them as bounded estimates. Cocktail and wine are low confidence: no direct Foz do Iguaçu bar or restaurant prices were found, so they are derived from the local beer price and a bottle-price reference. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of the Iguaçu tourist market, not inspected listings. FX: the 0.6720 observation dated 2026-11-18 was taken from search results citing the RBA exchange-rates page and RSS feed; the F11 table itself was not opened directly, so verify against the official table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Brazilian tourist city in Paraná state. Restaurant and grocery prices were benchmarked against Brazilian and comparable city cost-of-living indices (about 8% below the national average per one index). Accommodation was judged from the Iguaçu Falls tourism market, which carries a seasonal premium above the city average.
